ENV REDISPORT 6379

# Install dependencies.
ADD requirements.txt /app/requirements.txt
RUN pip install -r /app/requirements.txt

# Add application code.
ADD . /app

CMD ["gunicorn", "-b", "0.0.0.0:8080", "main:app"]
